deliverables.label: Raw Data
deliverables.text: We collect data from social media, websites, documents, video, audio, forums, public communities and other relevant sources, then turn it into structured datasets.

deliverables.label: Analysis
deliverables.text: We investigate patterns, actors, networks, narratives, developments and relationships to answer specific strategic, investigative or operational questions.

deliverables.label: Monitoring
deliverables.text: A one-off investigation becomes a continuous process. Relevant sources are collected regularly and checked for changes, new actors, narratives and other defined signals.

deliverables.label: Systems
deliverables.text: When standard software is not enough, we build custom collection, search, analysis and monitoring systems for organisations.

buyerFit.heading: When data becomes the basis for decisions.
buyerFit.intro: dynamiq. supports teams that need to understand what is changing across markets, platforms and public data sources.

areas.question: What is changing in our market?
questions: Which new offerings and categories are emerging?
How are positioning and pricing changing?

areas.question: How are brands and issues actually being discussed?
questions: In which contexts does our brand appear?
Which actors are driving issues and discussions?
Which visual and textual patterns recur?

areas.question: What can public data reveal about behaviour and trends?
questions: Which products and brands are gaining attention?
Which changes can be measured over time?

areas.question: How does unstructured material become a robust dataset?
questions: How can an investigation be documented reproducibly?

buyerFit.ctaHeading: Do you have a different question?
buyerFit.ctaText: If the data is publicly accessible, we can usually find a way to analyse it in a structured manner.

references.title: Document Intelligence
references.text: Nearly 5,000 government PDFs were analysed automatically, with suspicious documents subsequently verified by hand.

references.title: Platform Intelligence
references.text: We systematically investigated 357 TikTok videos using transcription, classification and analysis of the narratives they contained.

references.title: Market Signal Analysis
references.text: More than 400 public streams and around 4,500 company mentions were connected with market data and analysed over time.
